text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Once upon a time, long, long ago... There 
lived an old man and an old woman, and—

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Behold the majestic, glorious TM Opera O, 
descending upon wings of pure gold!

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
One day, when an old man, an old woman, 
and Opera O-chan went to the field to pull 
up a giant radish—

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Oh, what a miracle this is! Right there 
lie eleven daikon radishes, gleaming in 
golden light!! Old woman, begin cooking at 
once!

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Sure thing~. I'll whip up something 
amazing for you, Opera O-chan, so eat to 
your heart's content!

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Ah... Marvelous, Ms. Acute! Speaking with 
you brings forth an endless deluge of 
groundbreaking ideas for the stage!!

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
The opera "King Radish's Demon Slaying." 
When it's complete, I'd love to invite you 
to a special front-row seat!

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
My, oh my~, how delightful. I'll be 
lookin' forward to it.
